title: Medium Crate

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to transport items without the worry of items falling out

body:
"Crates can be used to store loose items and move them over long distances without accidently spilling them, this variant can hold a total of 4x8. Anchoring the create will anchor everything inside of the crate automatically.8"

Description

The Medium Crate costs $1090 and can be found near the Lighthouse. When used, it'll allow you to carry items across the map without the worry of dropping items.
